title: Optimization of an in vitro human blood–brain barrier model: Application to blood monocyte transmigration assays
author: Paradis, Leblanc, et al.

steps.title: Coat culture plates
steps.instruction: Coat each 100‑mm adherent cell plate completely with pre‑heated Attachment Factors: add 1.5 mL for HBMEC plates and 2.0 mL for NHA plates.

steps.title: Thaw and seed endothelial and astrocyte cells
steps.instruction: Thaw the cells and seed them into the coated plates with the appropriate culture media.

substeps.instruction: Add 10 mL Complete Classic Medium Kit with Serum plus antibiotics to the HBMEC wells.
Add 15 mL CSC complete serum‑free medium with RocketFuel plus antibiotics to the NHA wells.

steps.title: Incubate and refresh cultures
steps.instruction: Place the plates in a 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ incubator and add fresh medium daily for 6 days to obtain confluent monolayers.

steps.title: Detach cells for co‑culture assembly
steps.instruction: Gently detach HBMEC and NHA from their plates by sharply rapping the vessels with cell scrapers and Passage Reagent Group reagents, following the manufacturer’s protocol.

steps.title: Isolate peripheral blood mononuclear cells
steps.instruction: Isolate PBMCs from healthy donor blood using Lymphocyte Separation Medium according to the manufacturer’s instructions.

steps.title: Enrich monocytes and assess purity
steps.instruction: Enrich monocytes from PBMCs with the EasySep Human Monocyte Enrichment Kit (no CD16 depletion) per manufacturer; magnetic selection yields ~98 % purity, verified by flow cytometry. Stain isolated monocytes with CD14‑FITC and anti‑Biotin‑PE (labels non‑monocytes).

steps.title: Maintain monocytes before assay
steps.instruction: Culture freshly isolated monocytes in RPMI 1640 supplemented with 10 % heat‑inactivated fetal bovine serum, optionally adding PGE₂ to up‑regulate CCR7 expression.

steps.title: Harvest monocytes for transmigration
steps.instruction: On the day of the assay, detach monocytes using Cell Dissociation Buffer as described by the manufacturer.

steps.title: Prepare lower chambers with chemokine
steps.instruction: Remove NHA medium from the lower chambers of the BBB inserts and immediately add fresh medium. Add either 400 µL of 300 ng mL⁻¹ CCL19 diluted in NHA medium or 400 µL NHA medium alone (control).

steps.title: Refresh HBMEC insert medium
steps.instruction: Gently remove the HBMEC medium from the inserts and immediately supply the new solution.

steps.title: Add monocytes to upper chambers
steps.instruction: Resuspend 1.5 × 10⁵ freshly isolated blood monocytes in 150 µL NHA medium and add this suspension to each upper chamber.

steps.title: Incubate transmigration assay
steps.instruction: Incubate the assembled inserts at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ for 4 h.

steps.title: Collect and wash migrated cells
steps.instruction: Remove 300 µL aliquots from each lower chamber and wash the cells twice with 3 % BSA in PBS.

steps.title: Stain cells for flow cytometry
steps.instruction: Stain washed cells with APC‑conjugated anti‑human CD14 or the isotype control APC‑anti‑human IgG2a, each diluted 1:200 in 3 % BSA/PBS.

steps.title: Acquire and calculate migration
steps.instruction: Count CD14⁺ cells on a BD FACSCalibur, acquiring events for 60 s using CellQuest software. Calculate migration percentage by subtracting cells migrated with medium only from those migrated with CCL19, then express relative to the total cell number.
